newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Ex-Im Bank, others to lend PLDT $24 mln. [CORRECTED 9:04 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Japan Ex-Im Bank, others to lend PLDT $24 mln. [CORRECTED 9:04 GMT]

text.p: The Export-Import Bank of Japan said on Wednesday that it and other financial institutions had agreed to provide a $24 million loan to the Philippine Long Distance Telephone Company (PLDT) to develop telecommunications infrastructure in the Philippines.

The Export-Import Bank of Japan will provide $14 million (corrects from "billion"), or 60 percent of the total amount, while the project will be co-financed by the Bank of America and Sumitomo Trust & Banking Co Ltd, it added.
The loan will be used to purchase equipment and services through Marubeni Corp to improve and expand PLDT's telecommunications network, the Ex-Im Bank said.

In addition, PLDT, which is the largest private telephone company in the Philippines, plans to install a total of 2.5 million telephone lines by 2001. The loan will be used to finance part of that project, it added.
